title: REQ · Panel shows chapter title and a parchment dialogue card with portrait, speaker, line and choices
summary: Dialogue card with 32x32 portrait, speaker name, line and choices list inside the panel frame.
description: Context: StoryPanel renders the dialogue as bare h2, p and buttons without a portrait. Desired behavior: wrap the panel in sf-frame-panel with own overflow-y scroll, show the chapter title, and render the node in an sf-frame-parchment card with the speaker portrait resolved from the manifest. Expected result: card shows portrait, speaker, line and choices list. Why: reference UI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a node with speaker boy, when rendered, then an img of 32x32 from manifest id character:boy-portrait is in the Dialogue region.
Given a speaker with no manifest portrait, when rendered, then no img is shown and the speaker name and line still render.
Given a node with 2 choices, when rendered, then a list with 2 buttons appears and clicking the second calls onChoose(1).
Given no node, when rendered, then the title shows and no Dialogue region exists.
technical_constraints: Portrait comes from the existing generated manifest entry character:boy-portrait.
Palette and tokens shared with UI; no new colours.
definition_of_done: Dialogue card renders portrait, speaker, line, choices
Root panel is framed and scrolls on its own
